about: The extended series score (#1537): per-episode cue lists in each battle's palette. Nothing here is generated yet; 'score manifest' turns it into requests for the music service.
service: ElevenLabs Music, under the project author's licence that permits commercial use
rules: Under narration only beds, drones and sparse percussion, ducked 9-12 dB; never full-intensity music under words.
Big hits land in the gaps between lines; every climax is preceded by 0.5-1.5 s of near-silence.
Kingdom of Iron is the series theme: title, climaxes and end card. Each battle has its own palette.
Battle and climax cues are written for the ground cinematics that carry no narration.
No passage of 60 s or more is used twice in the series; only the 10 s title ident repeats.
Never combat_last_defensive_wall; reels and anything marketing use driving, upbeat cues.
The Iron Sepulcher (Skeletons Awaken) stays out of the series except, at most, a post-credits tease in episode 9.

kingdom_of_iron.use: series theme: title ident, every climax, every end sting, the trailer

dust_of_cannae.use: episode 7's battle motif; quoted in episode 9 when Scipio's veterans of Cannae fight at Zama

skeletons_awaken.use: excluded from the series; at most the episode 9 post-credits tease

bed.intensity: low, sustained, no melody that competes with a voice

battle.intensity: high, driving, written for ground cinematics with no narration

climax.intensity: full statement of the Kingdom of Iron theme in the battle's palette, opening from silence

elegy.intensity: low, slow, spacious; dignified rather than sad

reel.intensity: driving and upbeat from bar one; bed stems sit under the reel's lines

series_cues.notes: The title ident; the only passage every episode repeats.
Series trailer: builds from a lone drum to the full theme.
